<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Asistencia a Talleres</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#1f2430; --sub:#6b7280; --line:#e4e6ea; --bg:#f7f8fa;
    --card:#ffffff; --accent-periodo:#7c8ce0; --accent-semana:#e0956b;
    --accent-docente:#5aa7c9; --accent-curso:#7cb87c; --accent-seccion:#c98b5a;
    --si:#2f9e5c; --no:#c0392b; --row-hover:#f1f4fb;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{margin:0;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);}
  .wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 24px 60px;}
  h1{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 4px;}
  .subtitle{color:var(--sub);font-size:13px;margin:0 0 22px;}
  .filters{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:18px 20px;margin-bottom:22px;}
  @media (max-width:920px){.filters{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
  .field label{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .field.periodo label{color:var(--accent-periodo);}
  .field.semana label{color:var(--accent-semana);}
  .field.docente label{color:var(--accent-docente);}
  .field.curso label{color:var(--accent-curso);}
  .field.seccion label{color:var(--accent-seccion);}
  .field.asistencia label{color:var(--si);}
  select{
    width:100%;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;
    background:#eef0f4 url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="6"><path d="M0 0l5 6 5-6z" fill="%23888"/></svg>') no-repeat right 14px center;
    border:1px solid #e4e6ea;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 34px 10px 14px;
    font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;
  }
  select:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent-docente);outline-offset:1px;}
  .summary{display:flex;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:4px 0 18px;padding:14px 18px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;}
  .stat .n{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;}
  .stat .l{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--sub);}
  .tablewrap{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;overflow:auto;max-height:70vh;}
  table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:12.8px;}
  thead th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#fafbfc;text-align:left;padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:#4b5160;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;}
  tbody td{padding:8px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f1f3;white-space:nowrap;}
  tbody tr:hover{background:var(--row-hover);}
  .badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;}
  .badge.si{background:#e5f6ec;color:var(--si);}
  .badge.no{background:#fbe9e7;color:var(--no);}
  .empty{padding:40px;text-align:center;color:var(--sub);}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
  <h1>Asistencia a talleres — INDIVIDUO Y MEDIO AMBIENTE</h1>
  <p class="subtitle" id="subtitle"></p>

  <div class="filters">
    <div class="field periodo"><label>PERIODO</label><select id="f-periodo"></select></div>
    <div class="field semana"><label>SEMANA</label><select id="f-semana"></select></div>
    <div class="field docente"><label>DOCENTE</label><select id="f-docente"></select></div>
    <div class="field curso"><label>CURSO</label><select id="f-curso"></select></div>
    <div class="field seccion"><label>SECCIÓN</label><select id="f-seccion"></select></div>
    <div class="field asistencia"><label>ASISTENCIA</label><select id="f-asistencia"></select></div>
  </div>

  <div class="summary" id="summary"></div>

  <div class="tablewrap">
    <table>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th>Docente</th><th>Sección</th><th>Código Alumno</th><th>Estudiante</th><th>Asistencia a Taller</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="tbody"></tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</div>

Alumno": "U26322993", "Estudiante": "ZEVALLOS CUEVA, JOSE ANTONIO", "Asistencia a Taller": "No", "PERIODO": "26-3 Ago", "Semana": "4", "Curso": "INDIVIDUO Y MEDIO AMBIENTE"}];

const ids = ['f-periodo','f-semana','f-docente','f-curso','f-seccion','f-asistencia'];
const keys = {'f-periodo':'PERIODO','f-semana':'Semana','f-docente':'Docente','f-curso':'Curso','f-seccion':'Sección','f-asistencia':'Asistencia a Taller'};
const labels = {'f-periodo':'Todos','f-semana':'Todas','f-docente':'Todos','f-curso':'Todos','f-seccion':'Todas','f-asistencia':'Todos'};

function uniq(arr){ return [...new Set(arr.filter(v=>v!==null && v!==undefined && v!=='').map(String))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'es',{numeric:true})); }

function currentSelections(){
  const sel = {};
  ids.forEach(id => sel[id] = document.getElementById(id).value);
  return sel;
}

function filterBy(rows, sel, excludeId){
  return rows.filter(r => ids.every(id => {
    if(id === excludeId) return true;
    const val = sel[id];
    if(!val) return true;
    return String(r[keys[id]]) === val;
  }));
}

function fmt(v){ return (v===null||v===undefined||v==='') ? '—' : v; }

function updateDropdowns(){
  const sel = currentSelections();
  ids.forEach(id => {
    // opciones disponibles = valores posibles teniendo en cuenta los OTROS filtros activos
    const scoped = filterBy(DATA, sel, id);
    const options = uniq(scoped.map(r => r[keys[id]]));
    const prevVal = sel[id];
    const selectEl = document.getElementById(id);
    selectEl.innerHTML = '<option value="">'+labels[id]+'</option>' +
      options.map(v=>`<option value="${v}">${v}</option>`).join('');
    // conservar la selección previa solo si sigue siendo válida
    if(prevVal && options.includes(prevVal)){
      selectEl.value = prevVal;
    } else {
      selectEl.value = '';
    }
  });
}

function render(){
  const sel = currentSelections();
  const rows = filterBy(DATA, sel, null);

  const nAlum = rows.length;
  const nSec = uniq(rows.map(r=>r['Sección'])).length;
  const nDoc = uniq(rows.map(r=>r.Docente)).length;
  const nSi = rows.filter(r=>r['Asistencia a Taller']==='Sí').length;
  const pct = nAlum ? (nSi/nAlum*100).toFixed(1) : '0.0';

  document.getElementById('summary').innerHTML = `
    <div class="stat"><div class="n">${nAlum}</div><div class="l">Alumnos</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="n">${nSec}</div><div class="l">Secciones</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="n">${nDoc}</div><div class="l">Docentes</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="n">${nSi}</div><div class="l">Asisten</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="n">${nAlum-nSi}</div><div class="l">No asisten</div></div>
    <div class="stat"><div class="n">${pct}%</div><div class="l">% Asistencia</div></div>
  `;

  const tbody = document.getElementById('tbody');
  if(rows.length===0){
    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">Sin resultados para estos filtros</td></tr>';
    return;
  }
  tbody.innerHTML = rows.slice(0,3000).map(r => `
    <tr>
      <td>${fmt(r.Docente)}</td>
      <td>${fmt(r['Sección'])}</td>
      <td>${fmt(r['Código Alumno'])}</td>
      <td>${fmt(r.Estudiante)}</td>
      <td><span class="badge ${r['Asistencia a Taller']==='Sí'?'si':'no'}">${r['Asistencia a Taller']}</span></td>
    </tr>
  `).join('');
}

function onFilterChange(){
  updateDropdowns();
  render();
}

ids.forEach(id => document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change', onFilterChange));
document.getElementById('subtitle').textContent = `${DATA.length} alumnos, ${uniq(DATA.map(d=>d['Sección'])).length} secciones`;
updateDropdowns();
render();
</script>

</html>
